item.description:

In such markets, prices serve not only as a tool for price discrimination but also as a means of conveying quality information to consumers. This work introduces an optimization model to support decision-making in the design of integrated transit systems, with the aim of improving urban mobility. The reinsurer acts as a Stackelberg leader by choosing a common premium rate and an investment strategy, while insurers decide how much risk to retain and how to invest, taking into account their own performance, their performance relative to the insurer population, and common insurance-claim and financial-market noise. The outer approximation algorithm is a widely used method for solving convex mixed-integer nonlinear programs. While the algorithm is well established in theory and practice, certain assumptions underlying its convergence are rarely discussed in the literature.
